provenance.note: ROCC通用方法来自成品视觉推断；新增动漫方向由当前用户选题整理，尚未完成新一轮质量评估。

recipes.name: ROCC 风格
recipes.description: 以一个清晰角色为中心，把纸本墨线、故事细节与大块留白做成收藏级动漫壁纸。
recipes.description_en: One memorable character, tactile ink and story details, composed as a collectible anime wallpaper.
recipes.observation: 延续旧作中的主体轮廓、墨色层级与纸本质感；这是待作者校正的动漫方向，未训练模型。
recipes.observation_en: Draws on silhouette, ink hierarchy and paper texture observed in earlier work. An inferred direction, awaiting ROCC’s review; no model was trained.
recipes.composition: One expressive protagonist with a fully readable silhouette in the lower two-thirds. Use one large calm shape behind the figure, two purposeful narrative details, disciplined negative space and a quiet top margin. Make the image read like a collectible anime cover without any cover lettering.
recipes.material: Hand-inked anime linework on warm ivory paper, varied contour weight, fine cross-hatching, controlled halftone, one restrained vermilion accent. Keep expressive facial details and tactile paper without dirtying the silhouette.
recipes.avoid: unreadable silhouette, all-over grunge, busy wallpaper clock area, random mechanical detail, glossy generic 3D rendering, copied cover layout
recipes.demo_subject: 一位戴着护目镜的原创屋顶信使，手持地图，红围巾随风扬起，身后是层叠的小城与月亮
recipes.demo_subject_en: An original rooftop courier with goggles and a map, a red scarf in the wind, a layered hillside town and a quiet moon behind her

recipes.name: 七龙珠
recipes.description: 用夸张透视、清晰动作和受控的速度线，建立热血战斗动漫的爆发力。
recipes.description_en: Build a battle-anime moment with bold foreshortening, readable action and controlled speed lines.
recipes.observation: 研究方向：力量姿态、明快赛璐璐分区与冲击留白。不是官方素材或作者原稿复原。
recipes.observation_en: A study of power poses, clear cel-shaded color groups and impact space. No official assets or recreated source panels.
recipes.composition: A battle-adventure anime study associated with Dragon Ball: one heroic focal figure in a dynamic but anatomically readable pose, strong foreshortening, clear gesture line, a contained energy arc and sparse speed lines directed toward one focal point. Invent a new scene rather than reproduce a published panel.
recipes.material: Confident rounded-to-angular ink contours, clean cel-shaded blocks, warm orange against blue and a limited luminous accent. Keep hands, eyes and garment shapes crisp; energy effects must not hide the pose.
recipes.avoid: official title logos, copied panels, fake signatures, uncontrolled aura noise, unreadable hands, scattered energy balls
recipes.demo_subject: 一位原创短发武道旅行者在高山上练习腾空踢，橙色训练服，蓝色护腕，身后是云海
recipes.demo_subject_en: An original short-haired martial-arts traveler practicing a flying kick above a mountain, orange training clothes, blue wrist wraps and a sea of clouds

recipes.name: 火影
recipes.description: 用角色眼神、对角动势和疏密有序的墨线，讲一个安静却有张力的忍者故事。
recipes.description_en: Tell a tense shinobi story through an expressive gaze, diagonal motion and disciplined ink density.
recipes.observation: 研究方向：忍者冒险动漫的黑白节奏、速度和环境叙事，不使用村徽或官方图标。
recipes.observation_en: Studies ink rhythm, motion and environmental storytelling in shinobi adventure anime; no village insignia or official marks.
recipes.composition: A shinobi-adventure anime study associated with Naruto: one expressive ninja protagonist and a clear diagonal line of action, wind-driven fabric, a restrained environmental story such as forest branches or roof tiles. The gaze leads the composition; reserve a quiet upper area. Use a newly invented scene.
recipes.material: Crisp angular anime ink, dramatic but controlled black shadow shapes, sparse hatch marks and muted earth, charcoal and orange-red accents. Clear facial features and layered atmosphere, not full-frame noise.
recipes.avoid: official village insignia, copied page panels, logos, over-detailed background competing with face, tangled anatomy, fake calligraphy
recipes.demo_subject: 一位原创女忍者蹲在雨后屋檐，围巾和落叶被风吹起，眺望清晨山谷中的村庄
recipes.demo_subject_en: An original female shinobi crouching on a rooftop after rain, scarf and leaves in the wind, watching a village in a misty dawn valley

recipes.name: 哆啦A梦
recipes.description: 把圆润线条、简单色块和一个小小的奇妙道具，放进温柔清爽的日常场景。
recipes.description_en: Pair rounded contours and simple color blocks with one small imaginative gadget in a gentle everyday scene.
recipes.observation: 研究方向：日常科幻动漫的易读造型、亲切情绪与干净留白；示例采用原创角色。
recipes.observation_en: Studies approachable shapes, gentle emotion and clean space in everyday sci-fi anime. Example subjects are original.
recipes.composition: An everyday sci-fi anime study associated with Doraemon: one or two rounded, approachable subjects sharing a simple moment around one imaginative gadget, eye-level view, a calm home or neighborhood setting and plenty of open breathing room. Preserve complete silhouettes and an original scene.
recipes.material: Even clean rounded ink outlines, flat sky blue, ivory and a small red accent, soft cel shading and cheerful storybook simplicity. Keep shapes economical and expressions warm; no photorealistic texture.
recipes.avoid: official title treatment, copied gadgets or story panels, logos, excessive detail, uncanny 3D plastic, cluttered composition
recipes.demo_subject: 一个原创圆滚滚的薄荷绿小机器人和孩子坐在窗边，试用能把云朵折成纸飞机的小发明
recipes.demo_subject_en: An original round mint-green robot and a child by a window, testing a tiny invention that folds clouds into paper airplanes

palettes.name: 纸本暖色
palettes.prompt: warm ivory paper, muted amber and slate, with a dominant neutral ground

palettes.name: 暮光蓝紫
palettes.prompt: twilight blue, dusty plum and restrained warm amber, concentrated light rather than neon wash

palettes.name: 墨色苔绿
palettes.prompt: off-white, charcoal and muted moss green, clear ink-density hierarchy

palettes.name: 杏色留白
palettes.prompt: pale apricot, terracotta and a small dusty blue accent, large cohesive matte fields

legacy_recipes.name: 水彩剖面
legacy_recipes.description: 用一个完整轮廓，装下有层次的小世界。
legacy_recipes.observation: 大型轮廓、内部场景分层、纸张底色与细线条共同组织细节。
legacy_recipes.composition: One dominant, fully visible original silhouette, slightly right of center, readable at thumbnail size. Place two or three purposeful interior cutaway scenes inside it, each with a distinct role and consistent perspective. A clean perimeter and quiet upper area protect hierarchy.
legacy_recipes.material: Refined watercolor washes, precise graphite and restrained technical linework on pale paper. Soft pigment edges contrast with clear mechanical structure; paper texture stays subordinate.
legacy_recipes.avoid: franchise robot silhouettes, recognizable antenna crowns, arbitrary machinery, busy background, repetitive rooms, fake logos
legacy_recipes.demo_subject: 一顶内部藏着月面温室、探测车工坊和观测站的原创探索头盔

legacy_recipes.name: 墨色叙事
legacy_recipes.description: 让轮廓先成立，再让墨迹讲故事。
legacy_recipes.observation: 浅纸底上用深色主体和有方向的墨迹建立焦点，外围逐渐松散。
legacy_recipes.composition: One clear primary silhouette and focal feature. Concentrate intricate detail near that focus, simplify toward the perimeter, and use directional ink strokes to connect foreground and background. Preserve a quiet paper margin.
legacy_recipes.material: Charcoal-black and warm-gray ink on off-white paper, restrained dry-brush and controlled splatter. Ink density creates depth rather than a uniform noisy overlay.
legacy_recipes.avoid: recognizable manga characters, copied emblems, decorative calligraphy, uniform grunge, indistinct black blobs, competing focal subjects
legacy_recipes.demo_subject: 一只守望山林的原创银白狐狸，与身后若隐若现的古松和山雾

legacy_recipes.name: 暮光电影
legacy_recipes.description: 用远近尺度和一束光，把情绪留下来。
legacy_recipes.observation: 低明度前景、受控暮光与远处大型结构形成空间和叙事焦点。
legacy_recipes.composition: A small original foreground observer and one distant monumental structure establish scale. A clean horizon and deliberate leading line connect them. Place the brightest contrast at the narrative focus while retaining readable shadow detail.
legacy_recipes.material: Painterly cinematic dusk, desaturated plum, concentrated amber and believable reflected light. Clear spatial separation, no full-frame neon wash.
legacy_recipes.avoid: existing mecha silhouettes, copied movie scenes, neon everywhere, crushed shadows, multiple suns, gratuitous lens flares
legacy_recipes.demo_subject: 一名原创远行者站在潮湿盐湖边，望向暮光中缓缓升起的环形观测站

legacy_recipes.name: 一物留白
legacy_recipes.description: 把一个小小的主角，留在足够大的安静里。
legacy_recipes.observation: 单色底、小主体与少量笔触依靠位置和比例成立。
legacy_recipes.composition: One small complete original object, approximately 15 to 25 percent of frame height, in the lower-middle region. At least 65 percent calm negative space. One restrained supporting mark may ground it without becoming a second subject.
legacy_recipes.material: A cohesive matte color field and one crisp expressive object with a gentle contact shadow. Subtle tactile character, no decorative noise or excessive gloss.
legacy_recipes.avoid: existing cartoon mascots, extra objects, decorative typography, full-frame subject, unnecessary gradients, ungrounded floating object
legacy_recipes.demo_subject: 一只形状独特的原创赤陶小花瓶，插着一枝弯曲的蓝色野花，淡杏色背景

legacy_recipes.name: 繁色收藏
legacy_recipes.description: 颜色可以很满，视觉中心必须很清楚。
legacy_recipes.observation: 高密度装饰围绕中心人物，用重复纹样和有限主色维持秩序。
legacy_recipes.composition: One fully original central subject framed by a coherent family of thematic motifs. Distinguish large, medium and small detail bands; keep the face or focal feature clear. Motifs follow the frame rather than covering the subject.
legacy_recipes.material: Rich collectible print illustration in deep blue, ochre and moss, controlled line weight and subtle printed grain. Repeat colors to unify decorative density.
legacy_recipes.avoid: sports-team badges, commercial logos, existing anime characters, copied jersey designs, crowded unreadable face, random symbols
legacy_recipes.demo_subject: 一名原创森林天文学家，身边围绕树叶、星图、猫头鹰和机械星盘的装饰纹样

legacy_recipes.name: 微缩剧场
legacy_recipes.description: 像一件能握在手里的小小故事。
legacy_recipes.observation: 有触感的微缩主体、前后关系与暖光，让有限场景产生戏剧性。
legacy_recipes.composition: An original miniature scene with one action, a foreground threshold and warm interior light. At most two or three original figures with distinct poses and unobscured features. Meaningful overlap establishes depth.
legacy_recipes.material: Handmade clay and painted-resin tactile surfaces, subtle imperfections and soft plausible light; warm interior against a quiet darker exterior. No plastic oversmoothing.
legacy_recipes.avoid: existing toys or cartoon identities, crowded faces, copied doorway scene, uncanny anatomy, shiny generic 3D emoji, excessive blur
legacy_recipes.demo_subject: 两个原创蘑菇小精灵在微缩修伞铺里，暖灯照着一把刚修好的叶片雨伞
